subject.title: fix(mattermost): prevent hook-controlled replies from leaking previews

question: Should any registered reply_payload_sending or message_sending hook disable Mattermost provider previews globally, accepting reduced streaming UX to guarantee that pre-hook content cannot become visible?
rationale: The patch makes a deliberate operator-visible confidentiality tradeoff: hooks are dynamically registered and the runtime cannot generally determine in advance whether an individual hook will rewrite or cancel a particular reply.

options.title: Prefer hook-controlled confidentiality
options.body: Merge the Mattermost-local suppression behavior so replies remain invisible until the rewrite/cancellation-capable outbound lifecycle decides to send them.

options.title: Preserve previews with an explicit policy
options.body: Require a separately designed opt-in or capability contract before disabling existing preview behavior for installations that register outbound hooks.

recommendation.title: Prefer hook-controlled confidentiality
recommendation.body: Merge the Mattermost-local suppression behavior so replies remain invisible until the rewrite/cancellation-capable outbound lifecycle decides to send them.
